mintAuthority.summary: ACRDX is a permissioned NAV-accreting fund share issued by Anemoy via Centrifuge rails; primary subscriptions and redemptions are KYC-gated at fund NAV. Native issuance is scoped to the Ethereum Centrifuge ShareToken, where the Spoke and BalanceSheet mint and burn under the Root's ward administration. The Root is governed by the Centrifuge ProtocolGuardian backed by a 4/9 Safe multisig.

controls.label: Anemoy / Centrifuge fund issuance authority
controls.evidence: Permissioned fund-share issuance: Anemoy (through Centrifuge) mints ACRDX against KYC-gated NAV subscriptions and burns on redemption; transfers are restricted to whitelisted holders. No permissionless mint route.

controls.label: ACRDX Centrifuge Spoke ward (direct mint path — Ethereum, Plume, Monad)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25769985, wards(0xec3582fcdc34078a4b7a8c75a5a3ae46f48525ab) on the canonical ACRDX ShareToken (0x9477724bb54ad5417de8baff29e59df3fb4da74f) returned 1. The Centrifuge Spoke is the Ethereum contract that calls mint() and burn() for issuer-side, KYC-gated NAV subscriptions and redemptions; this control is scoped to the canonical Ethereum deployment.

controls.label: ACRDX Centrifuge BalanceSheet ward (direct mint path — Ethereum)
controls.capDescription: The ShareToken exposes no separate cap for this ward; issuance is bounded only by auth-gated mint/burn calls and Root ward administration.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25769985, wards(0x12a110ce5f0fc871cc72bc7ecaf35cf39dd0f43e) on the canonical ACRDX ShareToken returned 1. The Centrifuge BalanceSheet is an active contract ward with auth-gated mint() and burn() authority for issuer-side, KYC-gated NAV subscriptions and redemptions.

controls.label: ACRDX Ethereum Root ward (canonical protocol admin)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25769985, wards(0x7ed48c31f2fdc40d37407cbabf0870b2b688368f) on the canonical ACRDX ShareToken returned 1. The Centrifuge Root controls rely/deny of the canonical Ethereum wards, so its authority is retained here only for native Ethereum issuance.

controls.label: Centrifuge ProtocolGuardian Safe (Root authority)
controls.evidence: The Centrifuge ProtocolGuardian (0xceb7ed5d5b3bad3088f6a1697738b60d829635c6) has a safe() function that returns 0x9711730060c73ee7fcfe1890e8a0993858a7d225. At Ethereum block 25769985, ProtocolGuardian is warded on the canonical Root. The Safe is 4-of-9; the authored on-chain inspection recorded 9 owners, no enabled modules, and no guard at block 25295029. Its authority is retained here only to administer canonical Ethereum issuance wards.

review.evidence: Anemoy/Centrifuge materials describe a permissioned, NAV-accreting fund-share token. Ethereum confirmed at block 25769985: the canonical ShareToken wards include Root (0x7ed48c31f2fdc40d37407cbabf0870b2b688368f), Spoke (0xec3582fcdc34078a4b7a8c75a5a3ae46f48525ab), and BalanceSheet; Root is governed by ProtocolGuardian (0xceb7ed5d5b3bad3088f6a1697738b60d829635c6), backed by a 4-of-9 Safe with no enabled modules or guard in the authored inspection at block 25295029. Chronicle Proof of Asset continuously verifies ACRDX asset and NAV data from the fund administrator. The BVI FSC registry matches Anemoy Capital SPC Limited, the exact current professional-fund issuer. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-16: canonical Centrifuge wards can mint, the Root-controlled Safe can replace wards without a timelock, Chronicle continuously verifies NAV, and the BVI FSC supervises the exact fund issuer.
